measurement_scope: Synthetic training controls, dedicated same-configuration measured template forecasts, no neural accuracy claim. Resource names are hypotheses; retain actual allocated/reserved/device memory, successful-update rate, power and GPU busy. GPU busy is not SM occupancy.
budget_selection: Round dedicated calibration rate times the declared target duration to an integral two-epoch update budget, with a fixed 65536-update bound, before any policy evaluation. Report clipping and realized durations.
policy_contrast: Incremental versus revised removes only the historical reserve from the post-trial margin. Both retain future pause/resume costs, pre-trial exploration guard, stress scenarios and two measurement halves.
common_amendments: All new arms use the same cached epoch permutations, source-bound profile lookup, asynchronous preparation and added allocated-memory telemetry. Absolute differences from iteration1 are not policy-only effects.
